title: What Should We Remove? Evaluating the Reliability and Costs of RLVR Data Decontamination
abstract: arXiv:2610.21229v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) math corpora are routinely screened for benchmark overlap, but the reliability and data-loss costs of cleaning policies remain underexamined. We audit sixteen open RLVR math corpora comprising 1,673,514 corpus-specific training items against six benchmarks containing 1,949 questions. We evaluate eight policies based on exact, lexical, and semantic matching using 594 independently and blindly dual-reviewed training-benchmark pairs. Calibration and held-out sets have disjoint benchmark questions and training-example families. A separate review of all 83 candidate matches for 80 sampled training items measures item-level false removal. At cosine threshold 0.80, 52 of 59 sampled removals (88%) were confirmed false removals; this is not a demonstrated population rate. No semantic threshold in our preregistered grid (0.80-0.98) meets the 90% conservative-precision target on calibration. The

translated_title: 我们该移除什么？评估RLVR数据去污染的可靠性与成本
translated_abstract: 可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）数学语料库通常会针对与基准测试的重叠进行例行筛查，但清洗策略的可靠性和数据损失成本仍未得到充分检验。我们审计了16个开放的RLVR数学语料库（共包含1,673,514个语料库专属训练条目），对照包含1,949个问题的六个基准测试。我们基于精确匹配、词汇匹配和语义匹配，使用594对经独立盲法双重审核的训练-基准配对，评估了八种去污染策略。校准集与保留集的基准问题和训练样本族互不相交。此外，我们对80个抽样训练条目的全部83个候选匹配进行了单独审核，以衡量条目级别的误移除情况。在余弦阈值0.80下，59个抽样移除中有52个（88%）被确认为误移除；但这并非已证实的总体比例。在预注册的阈值网格（0.80-0.98）中，没有任何语义阈值在校准集上达到90%的保守精确率目标。
tldr: 该研究首次系统审计了RLVR数学语料库的去污染策略，发现语义匹配去污在余弦阈值0.80下有88%的抽样移除被证实为误移除，且没有任何预注册语义阈值能达到90%保守精确率目标，揭示了当前数据清洗政策存在严重的误删风险与数据损失成本。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically audits decontamination policies for RLVR math corpora and reveals that at cosine threshold 0.80, 88% of sampled removals were confirmed false removals, and no preregistered semantic threshold meets the 90% conservative-precision target, exposing severe false-removal risks and data-loss costs in current benchmark-overlap cleaning practices.
